purpose: Part 3/5 of verified exact 50-record item effect batch 030; together these files contain exactly 50 reviewed records from the 80-record checkpoint.

items/figurines-of-wondrous-power.name: Figurines of Wondrous Power
items/figurines-of-wondrous-power.effectSummary: On command, a figurine transforms into its creature, obeys its owner, and later returns to statuette form; if the statuette is destroyed it is permanently lost, while a creature slain in transformed form simply reverts. Bronze griffon: griffon 2/week for up to 6 hours. Blue quartz eagle: eagle with +5 Spot, telepathy with owner within 1 mile, cannot attack, and owner can see through its eyes as a standard action, usable 24 hours per tenday. Coral dolphin: intelligent dolphin (Int 5), speaks Common and Aquan, magical beast, 2/tenday for up to 4 hours. Ebony fly: pony-sized fly using hippogriff statistics without attacks, 3/week for up to 12 hours. Golden lions: pair of adult male lions, 1/day for up to 1 hour; if slain, unavailable for 1 week. Ivory goats are a trio: traveling goat becomes a draft horse for up to 24 hours/week then needs at least 1 day rest; travail goat becomes a nightmare-like mount with two 1d8+4 horns and can be used 1/month for up to 12 hours; terror goat becomes a light warhorse whose horns count as a +3 lance and +5 longsword and radiates a 30-foot fear effect (DC 16) when ridden to attack, usable once every 2 weeks for up to 3 hours; each goat permanently loses its magic after three uses. Marble elephant: elephant 4/month for up to 24 hours. Obsidian steed: heavy warhorse able to fly, plane shift, and use etherealness at will once per round; a good rider has a 10% chance per use of being sent to a Lower Plane, after which the statuette reappears; 1/week for up to 24 hours. Onyx dog: intelligent war dog (Int 8) speaking Common, scent, +4 Spot/Search, darkvision 60 ft., see invisibility; 1/week for up to 6 hours. Serpentine owl: horned or giant owl, 1/day for up to 8 continuous hours; after three giant-owl transformations the item loses all magic, and the owl can telepathically report what it sees. Silver raven: raven made of silver (hardness 10) that can carry messages as animal messenger or obey commands, usable up to 24 hours/week.

items/fochlucan-bandore-402.name: Fochlucan Bandore
items/fochlucan-bandore-402.effectSummary: This masterwork three-stringed lute grants +2 circumstance on Perform (string instruments) and +1 competence on bardic music checks for countersong, fascinate, and suggestion. Anyone can use it to produce light once per day. A character with at least 2 ranks in Perform (string instruments) can additionally use flare, mending, and message once per day each.

provenance.role: same-source family page supplies the complete rank thresholds, bardic-music bonuses, daily spell list, and underqualified-holder rule omitted/truncated on the individual item page

items/greatdominator-700.name: Great Dominator
items/greatdominator-700.effectSummary: This specific psicrown follows the standard psicrown power-trigger rules and contains 750 power points. It can spend those points only on these powers: psionic charm, psionic dominate, and psionic suggestion. The wearer may augment those powers with the crown's own points subject to the standard psicrown limit, cannot add personal power points, and may use their own manifester level if it is higher than the crown's.

provenance.role: same-source generic psicrown rules supply activation, augmentation, and manifester-level behavior; this item page supplies the point total and power list

items/hwyrr-clarion-harp-454.name: Hwyrr, the Clarion Harp
items/hwyrr-clarion-harp-454.effectSummary: This intelligent chaotic-good harp is a harp of charming with Int 18, Wis 10, Cha 18, speech, telepathy, darkvision/blindsense/hearing 120 feet, Ego 14, and the languages Celestial, Common, Draconic, Elven, and Gnome. It can use elation three times per day, dismissal once per day, fear three times per day against foes, and has 10 ranks in Knowledge (history) for +14 total. It also produces Faerinaal's hymn: while the hymn is maintained by concentration, evil targets in close range that can hear it must save or forgo attacks of opportunity. When combat occurs within 60 feet, the harp normally begins playing the hymn automatically until another of its powers is used.

provenance.role: spell cross-check for Faerinaal's hymn: evil hearers that fail Will saves forgo attacks of opportunity for the concentration duration

items/iasalas-watershod-456.name: Iasalas, the Watershod
items/iasalas-watershod-456.effectSummary: This intelligent lawful-good +1/+1 ki-focus quarterstaff has Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 10, speech, 120-foot vision and hearing, Ego 10, and understands Aquan, Celestial, and Common. It can use water walk on its wielder three times per day and has 10 ranks in Sense Motive for a +12 total modifier.

items/instruments-of-the-bards.name: Instruments of the Bards
items/instruments-of-the-bards.effectSummary: These masterwork bardic instruments all grant +2 circumstance on the appropriate Perform checks and scale by rank requirement. Fochlucan bandore: +1 competence on countersong/fascinate/suggestion; light 1/day usable by anyone; with 2 Perform ranks, flare, mending, and message 1/day each. Mac-Fuirmidh cithern: +2 competence; with 4 ranks, cure light wounds, mage armor, and sleep 1/day each. Doss lute: +3 competence; with 6 ranks, delay poison, hold person, and mirror image 1/day each; an underqualified holder gains one negative level. Canaith mandolin: +4 competence; with 8 ranks, cure serious wounds, dispel magic, and summon monster III 1/day each; underqualified holder gains one negative level. Cli lyre: +5 competence; with 10 ranks, break enchantment, dimension door, and shout 1/day each; underqualified holder gains one negative level. Anstruth harp: +6 competence; with 12 ranks, control water, mass cure light wounds, and mind fog 1/day each; underqualified holder gains one negative level. Ollamh harp: +7 competence; with 14 ranks, control weather, eyebite, and repulsion 1/day each; underqualified holder gains one negative level. These negative levels persist only while the instrument is held, never become actual level loss, and cannot be removed while held.

items/kiira.name: Kiira
items/kiira.effectSummary: Worn on the forehead and occupying the hat slot, the gem grants +2 competence on all Knowledge checks if the wearer spends a full round contemplating before the check. It also functions as an erasable spellbook holding up to 30 spells of any levels; recording and preparing spells uses the normal spellbook time and expense, and found kiiras may already contain spells.

items/living-figureheads.name: Living Figureheads
items/living-figureheads.effectSummary: A living figurehead animates on command and serves the ship's master; unless noted otherwise it speaks Common and communicates telepathically with its master within 100 feet. Breaking it while a carving ruins it permanently, while destroying it in animated form only returns it to carving form. Dragon Head: Large animated object, speed 0, +5 bite for 1d8+4, hardness 5, young-adult-dragon mental ability scores, 10-minute use once per week, breath every 1d4 rounds, and grants its ship matching energy immunity. Black: 80-foot acid line 10d4, DC 13, acid immunity; blue: 40-foot lightning cone 10d8, DC 14, electricity; green: 40-foot acid-gas cone 10d6, DC 14, acid; red: 40-foot fire cone 10d10, DC 14, fire; white: 40-foot cold cone 10d4, DC 12, cold; brass: 80-foot fire line 10d6, DC 14, fire; bronze: 80-foot lightning line 10d6, DC 16, electricity; copper: 80-foot acid line 10d4, DC 15, acid; gold: 40-foot fire cone 10d10, DC 16, fire; silver: 40-foot cold cone 10d8, DC 16, cold. Ebony Porpoise: doubles normal ship speed or propels a becalmed sailing ship as a strong wind, and can leap the ship over water hazards with the keel up to 10 feet above water for up to 15 nonconsecutive rounds/day; the speed ability is usable 3/week for up to 6 hours. Golden Shedu: grants fly 60 feet (poor) 2/week for up to 1 hour and can shift ship and crew to the Ethereal Plane for up to 10 total minutes/week. Purpleheart Kraken: once per week for up to 10 minutes, has eight 1d8+3 slams, 30-foot reach, improved grab and constrict, can grapple Large or smaller creatures and multiple Small or smaller creatures, can produce control winds as CL 15, and grants +8 on Profession (sailor) checks to initiate ship-to-ship grapples.

items/lunistra-heartstar-457.name: Lunistra, the Heartstar
items/lunistra-heartstar-457.effectSummary: This intelligent neutral-good item is a +4 soulfire breastplate with Int 12, Wis 10, Cha 12, empathy, 30-foot vision and hearing, and Ego 11. It can use cure moderate wounds on its wearer three times per day and normally readies that ability when the wearer falls to 0 hp or below; it may resist being ordered to waste healing.

items/mac-fuirmidh-cithern-420.name: Mac-Fuirmidh Cithern
items/mac-fuirmidh-cithern-420.effectSummary: This masterwork pear-shaped lute grants +2 circumstance on Perform (string instruments) and +2 competence on bardic music checks for countersong, fascinate, and suggestion. A character with at least 4 ranks in Perform (string instruments) can use cure light wounds, mage armor, and sleep once per day each.
